About this item

  • [4K Premium Image Quality] With UHD 4K resolution and a large Sony 1/2" CMOS sensor, this acer webcam for pc delivers balanced, true-to-life visuals, exceptional low-light performance, and superior light capture for clearer, brighter, detail-rich images. Ideal for streamers, gamers, and creators, this 4K webcam provides an exceptional experience for you and your audience.
  • [So Precise, It Feels Premium] Crafted from aerospace-grade aluminum with precision CNC machining, this 4K webcam features a seamless unibody design that’s both durable and elegant. Its A-grade sandblasted matte finish delivers a premium feel, while the all-aluminum body ensures fast heat dissipation for reliable 24/7 video performance.
  • [Advanced PDAF] Keep your audience engaged with responsive Phase Detection Autofocus (PDAF), delivering faster, more accurate, and more stable focusing than standard autofocus—ensuring crisp, clear 4K video without blurriness in any scene.
  • [Dual High-sensitivity Digital Mics] This 4K webcam, the web cam with dual high-sensitivity digital microphones, captures your voice clearly from up to 2.5 meters away while filtering out wind, keyboard clicks, and other ambient noise—delivering exceptional audio clarity in most scenes.
  • [Plug and Play] Connects via a single USB-C to A connection (USB-A to USB-C adapter included for wider compatibility). This plug-and-play laptop webcam is instantly ready to use—no drivers, apps, WiFi, or Bluetooth required. By relying solely on a secure physical connection with local data storage, it eliminates wireless signal risks, making it ideal for professionals and privacy-focused environments.
  • [Magnetic Privacy Cover Design] This 4K streaming webcam features a protective cover with 12 powerful built-in magnets that snap securely over the lens, keeping your privacy safe and blocking any unwanted peeks.
  • [Compact & Lightweight] At just 57 grams and about the size of a pair of earbuds, this 4K webcam is ultra-portable, letting modern mobile workers take HD video calls and recordings anywhere, from cafés to co-working spaces.
  • [Universal Compatibility] Works seamlessly with Windows, Mac, and ChromeOS, supporting all major video conferencing and streaming platforms like Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Twitch, and more, as well as being compatible with the Switch 2—for a hassle-free experience.
  • [Kind tips]Powered by Genuine Sony Japan Original Image Sensor Brand New & Factory Authentic – NOT refurbished, NOT pulled from used devices, NOT recycled parts

    True 4k. Well-built.
    I was choosing from different 4K webcams here in Amazon and stumbled on this accidentally. Glad I did! Build quality is phenomenal. The aluminum body matches the aesthetics of my whole setup. I like the magnetic privacy cover and the USB-A to USB-C adaptor that comes with it. I don’t even have to buy one for my Macbook. Image quality is true-4k via hardware and not via software upscaling. I easily use this to switch between having meetings or streaming. This outperforms even the more expensive options I’ve seen, in a sleek form factor too

      I’ve been using this webcam for video calls and content, and I’m really happy with it. The image looks noticeably sharper than my old webcam, especially in good lighting, and the autofocus has been quick without constantly hunting around.

      I also like that it feels solid and not cheap or flimsy. The privacy cover is a nice touch, and setup was basically plug it in and use it.

      The microphone has been clear enough that I haven’t needed to connect a separate mic for regular calls. Overall, it’s been reliable and the video quality looks really good. Very happy with this purchase.

It also connects via USB-C which is good and much more adaptable for other devices. I am really happy with this one, and even thinking on recording videos with it as I need it for meetings AND streaming.

    • K N
      4 out of 5 stars
      Overall a good webcam for its quality and ease of use
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on July 28, 2026
      Color: Black
      Vine Customer Review of Free Product
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The picture quality on this webcam is really good. It is clear, not grainy or blurred, and it reacts well to different lighting conditions. I mainly ordered this for Zoom meetings because my laptop camera just was not up to the job. The built-in microphone is another bonus. It picks up your voice easily without needing an extra separate microphone.

      The webcam comes with an adjustable mount, a user guide, a very long USB-A cable, and a magnetic disc lens cover. The mount unfolds so you can rest it on top of a monitor, place it on a table, or even attach it to a separate stand. One thing I really appreciate is that it is plug and play. You can use it straight out of the box without downloading any drivers. The cable just needs to go into a USB-A slot on your laptop or PC for power.

      This webcam does have settings you can adjust if needed, but for most people the default works fine. It arrived well boxed in normal branded packaging. As you would expect from Acer, it feels and looks very well made with great quality. Even if you are not very technical, like me, it is really easy to set up and use. Overall, I love that it is so straightforward, and it has been a solid upgrade for my video calls.
